'''Imei''' was eighth and outermost [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Felix/Legends|Felix]] in the [[Felucia system/Legends|Felucia system]],<ref name="EA" /> located in the [[Thanium sector/Legends|Thanium sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> Imei had three [[Moon/Legends|moons]] and was an [[Water/Legends|ice]] ball-type planet.<ref name="EA" />

==Behind the scenes==
All worlds in the [[Felucia system/Legends|Felucia system]], except [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]], were introduced in the [[2009]] sourcebook ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', co-authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]].<ref name="EA" />
